children: Armenia’s trade deficit widened to USD 516.2 million in August 2026 from USD 357.7 million in the same month last year.
Exports increased 1.3% year-on-year to USD 573.5 million, while imports rose 14.9% to USD 1,089.7 million.
Over the January–August period, the trade deficit reached USD 4,026.5 million.
During this period, exports declined 6.5% year-on-year to USD 4,623.9 million, while imports climbed 9.3% to USD 8,650.4 million.

title: Armenia Trade Gap Widens in August
